patterns.note: Two-column main content area with a fixed-width, centered container, featuring a primary content list on the left and a persistent 'About' sidebar on the right.
A single, clean sans-serif typeface is used throughout, with hierarchy established purely through size, weight, and subtle color variations for dates and and interactive links.
A high-contrast, monochromatic palette of white, dark gray, and light gray, punctuated by a single vibrant blue for interactive elements.
A sticky header containing the site title and main navigation remains at the top of the viewport, while the rest of the page content scrolls beneath it.
A dedicated, persistent sidebar section on the right provides author information, including a circular profile image, name, and a brief bio.

technique_notes: The header is implemented as a sticky element, fixed to the top of the viewport, allowing the main content to scroll underneath it without obscuring navigation.
The page employs a minimalist layout with a fixed-width content container centered on a white background, ensuring a focused reading experience with generous horizontal whitespace.
No scroll-triggered animations or reveals are used; the design relies on static content presentation and a clear visual hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Body text is legible, headings are slightly larger and bolder, and dates are smaller and lighter. The overall scale is subtle, emphasizing readability over dramatic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: sharp, except for the circular profile image
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous line-height for body text and clear separation between blog post entries. The main content area has airy margins.

standout: The site's design is remarkably spartan, prioritizing content readability and directness over any visual flair. Its standout quality is the extreme minimalism, presenting a blog as a straightforward list of links with a simple, fixed 'About' sidebar, almost like a digital resume or academic index rather than a typical marketing site.
